title: RedirectNamespace
description: One data/redirects/{who}.json: the shortener's slug -> target map for a single namespace. The filename is the {who} segment, so it is not restated inside the document.

propertyNames.$comment: Slashes are allowed: src/fetch.ts keys the lookup on the whole remainder of the path, so a slug may span segments. Mixed case is allowed because the lookup is deliberately case-sensitive.

additionalProperties.$comment: Absolute http(s) only - Response.redirect() throws on a relative target.
